description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale this outstanding six-bedroom family residence situated in the townland of Kilcreevanty, one of Tuams most sought-after residential locations which is just moments from Tuam town which provides ease of access to the motorway network.

This exceptionally spacious home extends to approximately 358 square metres (3,850 square feet) and has been handsomely upgraded and beautifully maintained throughout.

Occupying an elevated site with impeccably landscaped gardens, mature planting and a substantial extension, this is a home that delivers both space and quality in abundance.

From the moment you arrive, this property makes a striking impression. A beautiful local limestone boundary wall, sweeping driveway, mature gardens and extensive parking create an inviting first impression.

Step inside and you are welcomed by an impressive entrance hallway, complete with a bespoke wrought iron staircase that sets the tone for the quality of accommodation found throughout the home.

To the front, the generously proportioned living room features a large bay window that floods the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting setting for family living.

At the heart of the home lies a magnificent open-plan kitchen, dining and lounge area. This impressive space offers extensive fitted cabinetry, a generous dining area, a feature solid fuel stove with an attractive brick surround and flows effortlessly into a stunning sunroom featuring triple-aspect windows overlooking the beautifully maintained gardens and the rolling countryside beyond.

Also on the ground floor is an exceptionally spacious double bedroom complete with a bay window and a large ensuite, making it ideal for guests or multi-generational living.

A generously sized utility room leads into the extended wing of the house, which includes a spacious home office with its own ensuite, an additional rear room offering a variety of potential uses, a downstairs WC, and direct access to the rear patio. This entire wing has been fully soundproofed, making it the ideal space for those working remotely.

Upstairs, the outstanding landing area is fully illuminated by a feature apex  window overlooking the outstanding front gardens.

The luxurious master suite offers exceptional space and includes a bright dressing corridor with twin walk-in wardrobes providing extensive storage, leading through to a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom.

There are two further spacious double bedrooms on this floor, together with a well-presented family bathroom which completes the accommodation for this stunning family home.

Outside, the property continues to impress. To the rear, you'll find additional paved parking, a substantial steel shed with full planning permission, a wonderful patio area ideal for outdoor entertaining, and impeccably maintained lawns.

The property also benefits from solar PV panels and achieves an excellent B1 BER rating, ensuring impressive energy efficiency and reduced running costs.

If you are searching for an exceptionally spacious, beautifully presented six-bedroom family home that has been thoughtfully extended, tastefully upgraded and meticulously maintained, all set on an elevated site with stunning gardens, extensive parking, impressive outbuildings and within easy reach of Tuam and Galway City, then this outstanding Kilcreevanty residence could be exactly what you've been looking for.

If this sounds like you then we will be delighted to hear from you and to show you around.

Brought to you By Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales.
